dataNote: All values and effects in this scenario are illustrative game-balancing values, not NASA operational values or forecasts.

starterKits.name: Habitat Kit
starterKits.description: Extra alloy for an early outpost build.

starterKits.name: Field Kit
starterKits.description: Extra regolith collected from the landing zone.

starterKits.name: Science Kit
starterKits.description: An extra ice sample for a future greenhouse.

hazardZones.name: Dust front
hazardZones.log: The commander crossed a dust front. The storm cost energy and raised the abstract exposure-risk meter.

hazardZones.name: Thermal shadow
hazardZones.log: The crew crossed a cold shadow pocket. The training model reduced power and crew comfort.

firstActions.title: Bring the solar array online
firstActions.detail: Restore the outpost’s power buffer before the crew starts work.
firstActions.log: The solar array is online. The outpost has more stored power for the next sol.

firstActions.title: Run habitat diagnostics
firstActions.detail: Spend power now to check the habitat before the crew begins work.
firstActions.log: Diagnostics found a small maintenance issue. The crew repaired it before it grew.

dailyActions.title: Bring the greenhouse online
dailyActions.detail: Spend power and water now; the first food gain arrives next sol.
dailyActions.log: The greenhouse is built. It will start adding food next sol while using power and water.

dailyActions.title: Repair the habitat
dailyActions.detail: Use power and crew time to restore habitat condition.
dailyActions.log: The crew completed habitat maintenance before the next sol.

dailyActions.title: Activate life support
dailyActions.detail: Spend power to recycle more water and support the oxygen reserve on later sols.
dailyActions.log: The life-support module is online. It improves modeled oxygen and water recovery but draws power each sol.

dailyActions.title: Prepare the storm shelter
dailyActions.detail: Spend power to lower modeled exposure risk during future surface work.
dailyActions.log: The shelter is ready. Its modeled protection lowers risk over future sols.

dailyActions.title: Prioritize life support
dailyActions.detail: Reserve more modeled power for the habitat systems this sol.
dailyActions.log: Power priority set to life support. Optional work will use less energy.

dailyActions.title: Prioritize research
dailyActions.detail: Use more modeled power for science and accept a smaller reserve.
dailyActions.log: Power priority set to research. The crew can make more science progress this sol.

dailyActions.title: Send the science rover
dailyActions.detail: Spend power and water to investigate the nearby soil site; surface work raises modeled exposure risk.
dailyActions.log: The rover completed a short survey and returned a useful soil reading. The surface trip raised the game’s exposure-risk meter.

dailyActions.title: Schedule crew rest
dailyActions.detail: Use food and mission time to help the crew recover.
dailyActions.log: The crew took a rest period and recovered some wellbeing.

dailyActions.title: Conserve power and observe
dailyActions.detail: Keep optional systems quiet and let the crew review the outpost.
dailyActions.log: The crew conserved supplies and checked the outpost systems.

events.title: Dust on the solar array
events.trigger: Sol 2 · A dust veil reduces modeled array output.

choices.title: Ask the rover to brush the panels
choices.detail: Spend power and a little crew energy; restore the array branch.

delayedEffects.text: The rover cleared the array; modeled output recovered.

choices.log: The rover cleared a narrow path across the array. The crew spent extra energy, but the panels can contribute again.

choices.title: Wait for the dust to pass
choices.detail: Save supplies now; accept a smaller modeled power reserve next sol.

delayedEffects.text: Dust continued to reduce the modeled power reserve.

choices.log: The crew waited out the dust and conserved supplies. Less sunlight reached the modeled array on the next sol.

events.title: Water filter warning
events.trigger: Sol 2 · A filter sensor requests a maintenance check.

choices.title: Use the spare filter cartridge
choices.detail: Spend water now to improve the next recycling cycle.

delayedEffects.text: The serviced filter improved the modeled water reserve.

choices.log: The crew replaced the filter cartridge. The maintenance cost is immediate; improved recovery is expected next sol.

choices.title: Defer the filter service
choices.detail: Save supplies now; the water reserve may fall next sol.

delayedEffects.text: The deferred filter service reduced modeled water recovery.

choices.log: The crew deferred filter service to protect today's supplies. The water system may need attention soon.

events.title: Rover route blocked
events.trigger: Sol 2 · A small rockfall blocks the marked survey route.

choices.title: Send the rover along a longer route
choices.detail: Spend power; gain science and accept a small exposure-risk increase.

delayedEffects.text: The longer route returned a second set of useful soil readings.

choices.log: The rover took a longer route and returned a useful reading. Surface work increased the abstract exposure-risk meter.

choices.title: Hold the rover at the outpost
choices.detail: Protect the rover and crew; postpone the soil study.
choices.log: The rover stayed inside the marked safe area. The crew avoided the blocked route and postponed the survey.

events.title: Habitat pressure fluctuation
events.trigger: Sol 4 · The habitat monitor reports a modeled pressure fluctuation.

choices.title: Seal the secondary hatch
choices.detail: Use power and restore modeled habitat integrity.

delayedEffects.text: The sealed hatch stabilized the modeled oxygen reserve.

choices.log: The crew sealed the secondary hatch. Habitat condition improved in the game model.

choices.title: Isolate the affected section
choices.detail: Protect the main habitat now; reduce comfort next sol.

delayedEffects.text: The isolated section reduced the modeled leak rate.

choices.log: The crew isolated the affected section. The main habitat stayed protected while comfort dipped.

events.title: Water recycler stall
events.trigger: Sol 4 · The recycler needs a reset before its next cycle.

choices.title: Spend power on a careful reset
choices.detail: Use power now to improve water recovery next sol.

delayedEffects.text: The recycler restarted and improved modeled water recovery.

choices.log: The crew performed a careful recycler reset. It used power now, with recovery expected next sol.

choices.title: Ration water for one sol
choices.detail: Protect the reserve; crew wellbeing dips slightly.
choices.log: The crew rationed water for one sol and protected the reserve at a small wellbeing cost.

events.title: A signal from the soil site
events.trigger: Sol 4 · The rover flags a promising mineral pattern.

choices.title: Use the rover for a focused scan
choices.detail: Spend power to make science progress without a crew excursion.

delayedEffects.text: The rover's focused scan added a follow-up science result.

choices.log: The rover made a focused scan. This is authored game progress inspired by how remote instruments help scientists study Mars.

choices.title: Record it for a later study
choices.detail: Save power now and keep the observation for the debrief.
choices.log: The crew logged the signal for later analysis and conserved power.

events.title: A long shadow crosses the array
events.trigger: Sol 6 · Terrain shadow lowers modeled solar input.

choices.title: Shift optional loads to the battery
choices.detail: Protect essential systems; science work slows next sol.
choices.log: The crew shifted optional loads to the battery and protected essential systems.

choices.title: Keep the science instruments running
choices.detail: Gain science now and accept a smaller modeled power reserve.
choices.log: The crew kept the science instruments running through the shadow and accepted a lower power reserve.

events.title: Crew fatigue check
events.trigger: Sol 6 · The crew asks for a short recovery window.

choices.title: Protect the recovery window
choices.detail: Spend food to improve crew wellbeing.
choices.log: The crew used a short recovery window and returned to the work plan with improved modeled wellbeing.

choices.title: Take a brief rest and keep watch
choices.detail: Small recovery; retain more food for the remaining sols.
choices.log: The crew took a brief rest and retained more food for the remaining sols.

events.title: Soil sample needs a second look
events.trigger: Sol 6 · A sample seal may have been compromised.

choices.title: Use the lab kit to check the sample
choices.detail: Spend power and water for stronger science confidence.
choices.log: The crew checked the sample seal and logged a stronger result in the authored science model.

choices.title: Quarantine it and protect the lab
choices.detail: Avoid contamination; record less science progress.
choices.log: The crew quarantined the sample, protected the lab, and recorded a smaller science result.

events.title: The slope gives way
events.trigger: Sol 3 · A ridge of loose regolith slips across the marked path to the greenhouse site.

choices.title: Use the rover winch to clear a narrow path
choices.detail: Spend power and crew time now; keep the build site accessible.

delayedEffects.text: The newly cleared ridge exposed a useful soil layer for the survey.

choices.log: The crew opened a narrow route through the slide. It cost energy, but the greenhouse site remains reachable.

choices.title: Mark a longer route around the slope
choices.detail: Keep the crew rested; the detour delays a little science work.

delayedEffects.text: The longer route left less time for the soil survey.

choices.log: The crew marked a stable detour around the slope. The path is safe, but the survey will take longer.

events.title: A narrow relay window
events.trigger: Sol 5 · ORBIT predicts a brief communications window. The team can send one useful packet before the signal fades.

choices.title: Send the full survey packet
choices.detail: Spend stored power for a stronger remote science review.

delayedEffects.text: Mission Control’s review returned a follow-up question for the soil team.

choices.log: The full survey reached Mission Control. The stronger science return used power needed by other systems.

choices.title: Send a small compressed packet
choices.detail: Save power; receive a smaller science return and keep the rover independent.
choices.log: A compact packet made it through the relay window. The team saved power and kept its local plan.

events.title: The last sample window
events.trigger: Sol 7 · The rover camera spots one last exposed soil layer. The crew has time for one final plan before the flight review.

choices.title: Collect the final surface sample
choices.detail: Trade power, water, and crew energy for the strongest science result.
choices.log: The crew returned with the final sample. The study gained a strong result; supplies and recovery time were spent.

choices.title: Run a remote scan from the safe zone
choices.detail: Preserve the crew’s surface time and supplies for a smaller science gain.
choices.log: The rover made a remote scan from the marked safe zone. The science result was smaller, and the crew kept more reserves.
